claims: Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT
8:07 p.m. EDT is equivalent to 5:07 p.m. PDT
Splashdown completed a 10-day mission around the moon
Splashdown initiated recovery process by U.S. Navy and NASA teams
Splashdown time was 00:07 UTC on April 11
Splashdown location was Pacific Ocean near San Diego, California
Mission was a crewed lunar-flyby test flight
Recovery vessel was USS John P. Murtha
Crewed capsule re-entered Earth's atmosphere at approximately 7:53 p.m. EDT
Crewed capsule experienced a 6-minute communication blackout before deploying parachutes
Parachutes deployed for final 8:07 p.m. landing
